buttonSettingsTip: Add, remove and reorder toolbar buttons by dragging. Each button can be switched to a panel (container) via a toggle; its sub-items can freely be actions or quick phrases. Takes effect right after saving.
maxIconsTip: The toolbar fills the width by default. Once you add more buttons than this limit, the extras become horizontally swipeable.
overHint: {m} more, swipe left/right to reach them
previewEmpty: No enabled button - the toolbar is currently empty
previewOff: {m} more button(s) are disabled and stay off the toolbar
previewUnsetOnly: {m} button(s) have no action yet — pick one and they will show up on the toolbar
dragTip: Hold the handle and drag to reorder
migrated: Toolbar upgraded to the new defaults covering SiYuan's block menu
resetConfirm: Discard the current config and restore the nine built-in buttons (including panel contents)?
exportSaveDialog: System file manager opened. Choose a save location in the dialog (defaults to the Downloads folder, and the last folder is remembered).
jsonPlaceholder: Export opens the system file manager (defaults to Downloads; you can pick any path and the last folder is remembered). Or paste JSON here and tap "Import and apply".
exportSaved: Config saved to the chosen location:
exportFailed: Export was not completed, please try again
exportFallback: Config text generated; please copy the text area above manually
fileReadError: Failed to read the config file
emptyList: No buttons yet. Tap "Add button" above to start.
name: Name
popupOptionsTip: One per line, as Name|Content. Without the pipe, the name is also the content. {{date}} and friends are supported
pickIconNameHint: Tap the square to change its icon, tap the name field to type a name
iconTip: A SiYuan icon id (e.g. iconH1) renders the same icon as the toolbar; any other text is shown as a glyph
noSymbol: No SiYuan icon is available here. You can still type plain text or an emoji.
groupActionIcon: Action icons (all icons used by the action library)
groupBlockIcon: Block types (same as SiYuan's insert menu)
groupPanel: Panel presets (tap to open a sub-panel)
btnTipTip: Leave empty to fall back to the button name / action name
panelModeDesc: When on, tapping pops up a sub-menu; when off, it is a button that runs one action
panelModeHintOn: A panel can hold any number of sub-items, each one of the three behaviours (action / settings / quick phrase)
panelModeHintOff: Turn the switch on to make this button a pop-up sub-menu
kidInlineHint: Action and setting sub-items use SiYuan's own icon and name — tap the row to swap. Custom sub-items (quick phrases and renamed ones) are still edited right here in place
nameNoAction: Name (no action yet — pick one below)
nameEmptyPanel: Name (panel is empty — add sub-items below)
noChildrenNew: This panel is empty — tap "+ Add sub-item" below to pick an action, a setting or a quick phrase
emptyOptions: Please enter the phrase list first
noChildren: No sub-items yet. Tap "Add sub-item" below
noOptions: No options yet. Tap "Add option" below
nameNoSetting: Name (no setting yet — pick one below)
showSettingsEntry: Show settings entry at the end of the toolbar
showSettingsEntryTip: A gear button is appended after all buttons at the far end of the toolbar; tap it to open this plugin's custom-button settings. When the toolbar is full, scroll left to the very end to reveal it.
